description: This file defines interfaces for repositories related to users, orders, and tracking events within the delivery backend system, specifying methods for CRUD operations and data retrieval.

classes.name: IUserRepository
classes.description: Interface for user data operations, including adding a user, and retrieving users by ID or email.

classes.name: IOrderRepository
classes.description: Interface for order data operations, including adding, retrieving by ID, retrieving all for a user, and updating orders.

classes.name: ITrackingRepository
classes.description: Interface for tracking event data retrieval and addition, related to delivery tracking.

methods.name: Add (User)
methods.description: Adds a new user to the repository.

methods.name: GetById (User)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their unique identifier.

methods.name: GetByEmail (User)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their email address.

methods.name: Add (Order)
methods.description: Adds a new order to the repository.

methods.name: GetById (Order)
methods.description: Retrieves an order by its unique identifier.

methods.name: GetByUser
methods.description: Retrieves all orders associated with a specific user.

methods.name: GetByOrderId
methods.description: Retrieves all tracking events associated with a specific order.

methods.name: Add (TrackingEvent)
methods.description: Adds a new tracking event to the repository.
